38. UML use case diagram in depth

SIMPLE ENGLISH
A use case diagram maps external actors to goals offered by a system, not the internal
sequence of implementation steps.
සිංහJලෙන් Use case diagram එJකන් Customer, Admin වJගේ actors ලට system එJකන් කරන්න පුළුවන්
වුඩ Jපන්වනවා. ඇතුJළේ code flow එක JනJවයි.
A customer places orders and checks status; an admin manages products.

Pharmacy system · Place order · Track order · Customer Admin · Manage products · Read the diagram: Actors outside the boundary connect to goals inside the system. · System boundary එJකන් පිට actors සහ ඇතුJළේ goals බලන්න.

Actor Customer → (Place order), (Track order)
Actor Admin → (Manage products)
System boundary: Pharmacy System
Expected result: The diagram identifies user goals within the system boundary.

Q: Does a use case diagram show message order?
A: No. A sequence or activity diagram is better for interaction or workflow ordering.

Memory trick
Actor + goal + boundary.
